book.name: 1 Koronti
book.title: Pwoo ɗinshee ɗi Pool ran Nen Koronti mo

content: Ɗyemnaa mo, kaaɗe gyet wen jì pee wun ɗe, ɓe baa gyet wen satpwoo nwun nkaa mbii ɗesǝsok mǝ Naan nǝ mo a shi liispwoo ɗeshang kǝleng, kǝ man satpwoo mǝ seen kas.
Mɓǝɗǝ, kaaɗe gyet wen ashak kǝ wun, ɓe gyet wen kǝ ten lesen a kaa gwe ɗi baa wur man mǝ ɓe kas, a Jesu Kristi ɓejee, ɗe mo kǝ pwas wur nkaa shiyeepyoom sǝ.
Gyet wen ashak kǝ wun, ɓe wen a ndǝǝn cíinɓal, kǝ ndǝǝn kǝǝrmuut kǝ ɗaar zak.
Kǝ gyet pwoo ɗe wen kǝn sat nǝ, kǝ kám fen nǝ mo, baa gyet wen kǝn sat mo a shi pwoo ɗeshang kǝlǝng kǝ seen mǝ man satpwoo kas, amma gyet nǝ a ndǝǝn kám mǝ iiko kǝ Riin.
Mbeekǝ taji wu le shinzeen fuu mo tong a ndǝǝn seen mǝ gurum mo kas, amma wu le shinzeen fuu mo a ndǝǝn iiko kǝ Naan.
Ɗangɓe muu sat a pwoo ɗi mǝ man, pee nen ɗe mo kǝ wurang ndǝǝn mbii ɗe mo a mǝ Riin Naan. Baa man ɗǝsǝ nǝ a mǝ yil ɗǝsǝ kas, kǝ baa nǝ put a pee nen mulki mǝ yil ɗǝsǝ mo, ɗe mo mbǝ ɗel dǝm sǝ kas.
Ɗangɓe mun muu sat a pwoo nkaa man Naan ɗe nǝ a sǝsok ngurum mo, man ɗe Naan wur kǝ ten le mbe ɗeɗes fun akuɗang wur leyil nǝ.
Baa mee ngu mulki mǝ yil ɗǝsǝ mmak man mǝnǝ kas. Katɗang ɗe gyet moo man mǝni, ɓe baa gyet mon mpwas Daa ɗe hai nkaa shiyeepyoom kas.
Kaaɗǝ mo kǝ ten ran ndǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal sǝ nǝnee,

content.text: <<Mbii ɗi baa gurum kǝ cham naa kǝ yit kas,
<<ɗe baa gurum kǝ cham kǝlǝng nǝ shi kom kas,
<<ɗe baa pǝtuup gurum kǝ cham pan
<<mbii ɗe Naan wur kǝ tap ɗak nǝ le,

content: Ɗangɓe Naan wur kámshii mǝnǝ mmun a shi Riin fir, mɓeɗǝ Riin wur bǝlǝp mbii mo jir, har koo ɗi a jurum kǝ mbii aapwoo mǝ Naan mo.
A gurum ɗeɗang mmak man pan kǝ mee gwe yii? Katɗang baa a riin kǝ gwe nǝ kas yii? Nǝ aasǝ zak, baa mee ngwar cham man pan Naan kas, naa tǝng a Riin Naan ɓejee ɗak.
Baa mun mu kat a riin mǝ yil ɗǝsǝ kas, amma mǝ lap a Riin Naan, mbǝkǝ mu manshii kǝ mbii ɗe Naan wur ten shìn mmun ɗe.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ, pwoo ɗe muu sat nwun, baa nǝ put a mɓut mman mǝ gurum kas, amma a Riin wur woo nǝ mmun. Riin nǝ wur woo zeen, mbe nen ɗe mo kǝ Riin Naan ndǝǝn pǝtuup fur mo.

Ngwar ɗi baa wu kǝ Riin kǝ Naan ndǝǝn pǝtuup fin kas, ɓe baa wur mak lap zuum ɗe mo a mǝ Riin Naan kas. Mɓǝɗǝ mbii ɗe mo a mǝ Riin Naan, mo a pwoo ɗebuu pee gwe mǝnǝ ɗi, kǝzak, baa pan kǝ gwe mǝnǝ mak manshii mo nǝ kas, mɓeɗǝ a Riin Naan kǝ mak le gurum man mbii ɗǝsǝ nǝ mo.
Ngwe ɗewur kǝ Riin Naan ndǝǝn pǝtuup fir, ɓe wur mak manshii mbii ɗǝsǝ nǝ mo, amma baa mee gurum mak tokɗyeel nwur kas.
Kaaɗǝ mo kǝ ten ran ndǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal kǝ Naan sǝ nǝnee,

content.text: <<A wii kǝ man pan Daa yii?

content: amma mun kǝ pǝtuup mǝ Kristi.
